gate_claims.claim: veritriage.explain_log takes one path to a file; a missing path or a directory is refused
explain_log returns annotated regions, each with a line number, an origin, a phase and the line's text
explain_log annotates a log by origin and phase (committed test)
explain_log returns its regions as data
veritriage.investigate reports a classification, a confidence, a count of evidence nodes and a top hypothesis, and saves a session whose id it returns
the investigate run returns a session reference (committed test)

the fixture log of an assertion before a timeout matches the pattern
